description.value:
You've deepened the bonds of your soul-sworn oaths. As long as you are within 10 feet of the target of your soul-sworn oath, you each gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Will save against fear effects. If you are both @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened], whenever the value of the frightened condition decreases for one of you, it decreases by 1 for the other as well.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.Effect: Soul-Sworn Bravery]
